source.note: Songle data is a timing reference. Strong kick/blow and lyric-emphasis anchors should be added manually.

tempo.feel: hard four-beat grid with sharp impact accents

primaryDirections.summary: Keep the world mostly dark, with hard attention beams, camera flashes, and eye-like highlights cutting into the scene.
Use selected kick/stab moments as collision blows. Avoid shaking every beat; reserve big force for section turns and strong accents.
Represent public bashing through arrows, pointing shapes, warning marks, notification bursts, and flash lines aimed at a central subject.
Treat the interlude as a frozen evidence room: objects float, time drags, and user input responds late.

sceneModel.summary: A dark intersection where cars, signals, and road marks keep stopping and re-starting without resolution.
Roads fold into a dead end while warning lights, shadows, and repeated chorus pulses stack up.
The subject is locked under concentrated attention. Use this as a temporary overlay or full scene when blame becomes central.
A separate, uncanny temporal layer for the instrumental interlude.
